[EVALUATION RESULT]
Question: Let \(\Itre:=\{\, i(T)\mid T \text{ is a tree}\,\}\subseteq \mathbb N\), where \(i(T)\) denotes the number of independent sets of the tree \(T\) (an independent set is a set of vertices no two of which are adjacent). Define its lower growth exponent by
\[
\dimm(\Itre):=\liminf_{N\to\infty}\frac{\log |\Itre\cap\{1,\dots,N\}|}{\log N}.
\]
If \(\tau:=1+\sqrt2\), which quantitative lower bound holds for \(\dimm(\Itre)\)?
Predicted label: 'A'
Predicted text: '\\[\\dimm(\\Itre)\\ge \\frac{\\log_{\\tau}2}{4}\\approx 0.1966.\\]'
Correct label: 'A'
Correct text: '\\[\\dimm(\\Itre)\\ge \\frac{\\log_{\\tau}2}{4}\\approx 0.1966.\\]'
Exact Match: 1.0
